definitions.gloss: stone construction; built of stone; stonework
definitions.explanation: A building, structure, or object made primarily of stone. Also used as a modifier to describe something built from stone.

examples.japanese: {石造|いしづく}りの{橋|はし}を{渡|わた}る。
ヨーロッパには{石造|いしづく}りの{建物|たてもの}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many stone buildings in Europe.

examples.japanese: この{教会|きょうかい}は{百年以上前|ひゃくねんいじょうまえ}に{建|た}てられた{石造|いしづく}りの{建築物|けんちくぶつ}だ。
examples.english: This church is a stone structure built over a hundred years ago.

notes:
USAGE:
{石造|いしづく}り is typically used as a modifier before nouns using the の particle: {石造|いしづく}りの{建物|たてもの}. It can also stand alone as a noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {石造|いしづく}りの{家|いえ} (stone house)
- {石造|いしづく}りの{壁|かべ} (stone wall)
- {石造|いしづく}りの{蔵|くら} (stone storehouse)

RELATED PATTERNS:
The ～{造|づく}り pattern is productive: {木造|もくぞう}り (wooden construction), {鉄筋|てっきん}コンクリート{造|づく}り (reinforced concrete construction).
